# Robert Egert Studio

Robert Egert is a painter based in Ontario, Canada. This site is the primary archive of his work.

## Current Work
The most recent series, Small Worlds (2024-2026), consists of small-scale oil paintings on canvas and board. These works are available for purchase by inquiry.
URL: https://robertegert.com/current-work/

## Catalogue
A complete catalogue of paintings and works on paper from 1984 to present, organized by series: Nocturnes, Preparatory Academy, Cliffs, Anthropocene, Bonsai Garden, Morphopolis, Gothic Interiors, Towers, Unbearable Sculpture, Gag Furniture, Late 20th Century, Banners & Inscriptions, and Early Work.
URL: https://robertegert.com/catalogue/

## Bio
Artist biography, exhibition history, and selected publications.
URL: https://robertegert.com/bio/

## Ephemera
Essays, interviews, press coverage, and related documents.
URL: https://robertegert.com/ephemera/

## Contact
Gallery and curatorial inquiries welcome.
URL: https://robertegert.com/contact/
